attempts.diagnosis: The outer loop invariant at line 189 cannot be preserved for the key just processed. After the inner loop, the guard !(counter < m[key]) gives counter >= m[key], but the inner invariant only gives counter <= m[key] + 1. Thus Dafny cannot conclude counter == m[key], so it cannot prove multiset(s)[key] == m[key] after removing key from keys. The inner loop bound is one too weak.
